description: This file defines the `HealthClient` class, a client used to interact with AWS Health APIs and Notifications service. It extends the `AwsClient` class and provides method annotations for various AWS Health operations, both synchronous and asynchronous versions.

classes.name: HealthClient
classes.description: A client class used to interface with AWS Health APIs and Notifications, providing methods to describe affected accounts, entities, event details, and service status, among others.

methods.name: describeAffectedAccountsForOrganization
methods.description: Method to describe affected accounts for an organization.

methods.name: describeAffectedEntitiesForOrganization
methods.description: Method to describe affected entities for an organization.

methods.name: describeEntityAggregatesForOrganization
methods.description: Method to describe entity aggregates for an organization.

methods.name: describeEventDetailsForOrganization
methods.description: Method to retrieve event details for an organization.

methods.name: describeEventsForOrganization
methods.description: Method to describe events for an organization.

methods.name: describeHealthServiceStatusForOrganization
methods.description: Method to describe AWS Health service status for an organization.

methods.name: disableHealthServiceAccessForOrganization
methods.description: Method to disable Health service access for an organization.

methods.name: enableHealthServiceAccessForOrganization
methods.description: Method to enable Health service access for an organization.
